I've ported the server to Go and it passes all 4 example cases in `node check.mjs`. It uses only the standard library, so `build.sh` just runs `go build` and writes the binary to `./app`.

The code is split into three parts:
- **`main.go`:** checks the port argument, listens on `127.0.0.1:<port>`, and shuts down cleanly on SIGINT/SIGTERM.
